title: Staying Healthy
setting: A small house with a garden, a bright kitchen and a bathroom.

characters.name: Emma
characters.look: Emma, a young woman with short brown hair and a green shirt

characters.name: Ali
characters.look: Ali, a young man with black hair and a blue sweater

sentences.en: Emma and Ali want to be healthy.
sentences.zh: 艾玛和阿里想要保持健康。
sentences.scene_prompt: Emma, a young woman with short brown hair and a green shirt and Ali, a young man with black hair and a blue sweater stand in the bright kitchen in sports clothes, smiling.

sentences.en: They exercise with music in their ears.
sentences.zh: 他们戴着耳机听着音乐锻炼。
sentences.scene_prompt: Emma, a young woman with short brown hair and a green shirt and Ali, a young man with black hair and a blue sweater jog in the garden wearing small earphones.

sentences.en: For breakfast, they eat fruit and vegetables.
sentences.zh: 早饭他们吃水果和蔬菜。
sentences.scene_prompt: Emma, a young woman with short brown hair and a green shirt and Ali, a young man with black hair and a blue sweater sit at the kitchen table with plates of fruit and fresh vegetables.

sentences.en: Ali puts lots of salt on his eggs.
sentences.zh: 阿里在鸡蛋上撒了很多盐。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ali, a young man with black hair and a blue sweater shakes a salt shaker hard over a plate of eggs.

sentences.en: Emma's eyes go wide: “That is dangerous!”
sentences.zh: 艾玛瞪大眼睛：“那很危险！”
sentences.scene_prompt: Emma, a young woman with short brown hair and a green shirt stares with wide eyes at the salt shaker in Ali, a young man with black hair and a blue sweater's hand.

sentences.en: Here is a fact: water is the best drink.
sentences.zh: 有个事实：水是最好的饮料。
sentences.scene_prompt: Emma, a young woman with short brown hair and a green shirt hands a big glass of water to Ali, a young man with black hair and a blue sweater at the kitchen table.

sentences.en: Before bed, he never forgets his toothbrush and toothpaste.
sentences.zh: 睡觉前，他从不忘记牙刷和牙膏。
sentences.scene_prompt: In the bathroom at night, Ali, a young man with black hair and a blue sweater puts toothpaste on his toothbrush.

sentences.en: With a clean mouth, Ali goes to sleep.
sentences.zh: 嘴巴干干净净，阿里去睡觉了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ali, a young man with black hair and a blue sweater sleeps peacefully in bed with a small smile.
